title: Administrative Operations Manager(Front Office)
description:
Administrative Operations Manager(Front Office) InsideHigherEd•Rio de Janeiro, Sudeste, Brazil

JOB PURPOSE:

The Administrative Operations Manager (Front Office) serves as the operational and administrative anchor of the Office of the Dean and is the primary front-facing representative for the College of Arts & Sciences. Reporting to the Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration, this role is responsible for managing day-to-day administrative operations, front office services, facilities coordination, vendor and procurement activities, and student staff supervision to ensure a professional, efficientated Dean’s Office.

SUPERVISORY AUTHORITY:

  • Supervises front desk staff and work-study students assigned to the Office of the Dean
  • Responsible for scheduling, training, task assignment, and performance feedback for student and administrative support staff
  • Provides functional guidance to administrative staff supporting front office operations
    • >

    NATURE AND SCOPE:

    The Administrative Operations Manager (Front Office) works closely with the Dean, Chief of Staff, Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration, associate deans, faculty, staff, students, visitors, vendors, and university service partners (e Procurement, IT).

    This role exercises independent judgment in managing administrative operations, resolving day-to-day issues, and coordinating resources to support executive leadership and college-wide operations.

    PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

    Front Office & Executive Operations

    • Serve as the primary front office presence for the Office of the Dean, ensuring a professional, welcoming, and well-managed environment
    • Manage front desk operations, visitor reception, and daily office readiness
    • Coordinate administrative logistics for meetings, events, and executive activities within the Dean’s Office
    • Maintain consistent front office protocols and service standards

    Administrative Operations & Workflow Management

    • Establish and maintain administrative procedures, workflows, and internal operating practices for the Office of the Dean
    • Manage document control, records management, and administrative filing systems
    • Draft, maintain, and update non-HR administrative standard operating procedures (SOPs)
    • Coordinate internal communications and administrative scheduling within the Dean’s Office

    Student & Administrative Support Oversight

    • Supervise work-study students and front desk staff, including scheduling, onboarding, task delegation, and time submission coordination
    • Ensure adequate front office coverage and operational continuity
    • Support administrative onboarding logistics for new staff (workspace readiness, access coordination, supplies), referring all HR-related actions to the HR Operations Coordinator

    Facilities & Building Operations

    • Serve as the primary point of contact for facilities, maintenance, and building operations for the Office of the Dean
    • Coordinate building safety, space readiness, and maintenance requests
    • Monitor office infrastructure needs and elevate issues as appropriate to Facilities Management

    Vendor, Procurement & Resource Management

    • Coordinate procurement of goods and services in accordance with university policies
    • Manage vendor relationships, service agreements, renewals, and pricing coordination
    • Track contracts, service timelines, and vendor deliverables (non-legal review)
    • Maintain inventory, office supplies, and resource allocation for the Dean’s Office
    • Oversee procurement card (P-Card) activity, including transaction processing, reconciliation, and compliance with university procurement policies

    Operational Partnership & Special Projects

    • Partner with the Chief of Staff on administrative initiatives, operational improvements, and special projects
    • Support the Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration with administrative coordination and operational reporting as needed
    • Identify opportunities to improve front office efficiency, service delivery, and administrative consistency
    • Coordinates domestic and international travel arrangements for the Dean, as needed, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and adherence to university travel guidelines

    CORE COMPETENCIES:

    • Strong knowledge of administrative and office operations principles
    • Demonstrated ability to manage front office services in a complex academic environment
    • Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
    • Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality
    • Strong vendor coordination and procurement management skills
    • Ability to supervise and develop student and administrative support staff
    • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and operate independently
    • Working knowledge of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, including Workday.
    • Proficiency with office productivity tools (Word, Excel, Outlook) and administrative systems

    MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

    • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, public administration, or a related field
    • 4–6 years of progressively responsible experience in administrative or operations management
    • Experience supporting executive offices or senior leadership preferred
    • Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered

    Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

    $55,000-$65,000

title: Sr Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

Reporting to the Solution Consulting Director and based in Brazil, the candidate will be responsible for all technical aspects of the sales cycle related to geomodelling solutions, while ensuring the highest standard of customer satisfaction. The candidate will play a key role in the development and execution of pre-sales activities for geomodelling workflows, with deep expertise in SKUA, RMS, and subsurface characterization.

Your Impact

  • Provide advanced technical support and consulting in Aspen SKUA and Aspen RMS geomodelling software.
  • Prepare, present, and propose workflows for structural modeling, property modeling, seismic interpretation integration, reservoir characterization, and uncertainty analysis.
  • Search, uncover, understand, and analyze client/prospect needs and requirements to grow or penetrate accounts.
  • Conduct technical presentations and demonstrations on the AspenTech SSE subsurface applications suite, with emphasis on SKUA and RMS.
  • Present integrated workflows combining geomodelling software with other tools in the AspenTech suite (e.g., seismic interpretation, petrophysics, flow simulation).
  • Conduct pilot projects showcasing geomodelling workflows, demonstrating differentiators of SKUA/RMS versus equivalent market solutions.
  • Co-develop sales proposals together with the sales team.
  • Run advanced demonstrations and presentations at customer sites, workshops, and trade shows.
  • Identify, evaluate, and recommend proof-of-concept and evaluation opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with users through personal contact, onsite engagements, and user group meetings.
  • Communicate with product managers and developers on issues identified from field observations and customer feedback.
  • Training – Deliver high-quality basic and advanced training on geomodelling workflows and modules within SKUA and RMS.
  • Support – Provide troubleshooting and advanced user assistance; own issues until resolution or appropriate escalation. Demonstrate proficiency with internal support procedures and tracking systems.
  • Professional Development – Continue to actively develop technical expertise in geomodelling methodologies, reservoir characterization, and integrated subsurface workflows. Seek opportunities for personal development of non-technical competencies.
  • Technical Reporting – Complete and submit Consultant Activity Reports after each project in a timely manner.
  • Provide feedback to R&D and Product Management to contribute to continued improvement of our geoscience solutions.
  • Software Consulting – Deliver consulting services to execute tasks and produce deliverables related to structural modeling, reservoir modeling, seismic-to-simulation workflows, and geomodelling.
  • Write papers or technical abstracts for local and international events, demonstrating the value of AspenTech SSE geomodelling technologies.

What You'll Need

  • BS in Geology, Reservoir Engineering, or related subsurface discipline; MS preferred with more than 5–7 years of relevant experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of geomodeling, reservoir characterization, structural modeling, property modeling, and uncertainty workflows.
  • Experience working with complex geological settings such as carbonates, unconventionals, tight sands, salt tectonics, and structurally complex reservoirs.
  • Expertise in handling subsurface datasets: seismic interpretations, well logs, geological maps, core data, and reservoir simulation grids.
  • Capable of conducting high-quality basic and advanced classroom training on SKUA and RMS modules and workflows.
  • Background in multidisciplinary collaboration to improve integrated interpretation and modeling results.
  • Experience with data management, quality control, and subsurface data integration workflows.
  • Proficiency with geomodeling applications, especially SKUA and RMS (mandatory).
  • Knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Excellent technical communication skills in English; Portuguese and Spanish strongly preferred.
  • Strong presentation and storytelling skills for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and willing to take initiative.
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team when required.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to mentor younger professionals.
  • Able to interact effectively with other departments and multidisciplinary colleagues.
  • Strong commitment to deadlines and customer satisfaction.
  • Comfortable working in a multicultural business environment.
  • Flexible – must be able to travel.

title: Senior Manager, Retail & Licensing
description:
Senior Manager, Retail & Licensing

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Retail & Licensing Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Commercial Operations team, and work in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Head of Licensing & Retail and other key individuals responsible for delivering Licensing & Retail efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source, manage licensing domestic partners in coordination, collaboration and liaison with the FIFA Licensing & Retail (L&R) team in Zurich and aligned with the overall global L&R strategy to ensure the presence of a comprehensive, commercial and compelling range of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ licensed products in Brazil.
  • Develop and implement a national strategic licensing & retail plan in consultation and with approval of FIFA Licensing & Retail team in Zurich and aligned with the global Licensing Strategy. This will include planning product assortment, pricing, and distribution channels to maximize revenue and brand exposure in line with the overall Strategy for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA Licensing, Legal, Financial and Commercial Guidelines working with internal stakeholders.
  • Oversee the implementation and manage the approval of all brand executions (licensed products, packaging, pos, etc.).
  • Manage and oversee the production, quality control, and timely delivery of licensed products coordinating with suppliers, manufacturers, and distributors.
  • Analyse market trends, consumer behaviours, and competitor activities to identify new licensing and retail opportunities and optimize sales potential.
  • Manage relationships with retail partners, including brick-and-mortar stores, online platforms, and official FIFA Stores, ensuring brand consistency and driving sales growth.
  • Monitor and analyse sales performance, inventory levels, and consumer feedback to make data-driven decisions and implement corrective actions if needed.
  • Collaborate with FIFA Legal and Brand Protection to enforce licensing agreements, protect intellectual property rights, and prevent unauthorized use of FIFA trademarks.
  • Provide regular reports and presentations on Licensing & retail activities, including sales performance, market insights, and recommendations for improvement, to senior management and stakeholders.
  • Work with the relevant teams in the Brazil entity to stay informed on key milestones, activations, local and domestic implementations.
  • Oversee royalty reporting, ensure timely payment of remuneration and report back to L&R team in HOF.
  • Manage the contract management process via FIFA’s online system (BrandComply) and ensure the licensees adhere to this process.
  • Assist the L&R team in Zurich with the selection and appointment of retail concessionaires.

Your Profile

Education: Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education in Marketing, Business Administration, Product Management.

Experience: Minimum of 7 years of work experience in licensing and/or event retail in Brazil with preference in the sports or entertainment industry. At least 3 years’ experience leading a team.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Solid communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
  • Thorough knowledge Brazilian market, retail, consumer products and sports and entertainment trends
  • Excellent understanding of product development, go-to-market processes, and retail distribution models
  • Positive and can-do attitude
  • Strategic thinker whilst tactical implementor
  • Highly organised and with a structured approach
  • Financial and legal understanding
  • Comfortable working in a cross-cultural and cross functional team
  • Stress resilient and used to working to tight deadlines.
  • Solid understanding of omni-channel retail
  • Understanding of complex stakeholder rights models

Requirements:

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Team Lead - Digital Twin Platform
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the 'Control Room' and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s 'Visualizations' and that the 'Data Pipelines' are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert': When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Must Haves:

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

A Divisão de Grande Público porta a marca número 1 de beleza no mundo com L'Oréal Paris, a marca número 1 de maquiagem com Maybelline New York, a marca natural número 1 com Garnier. A DPGP é a maior divisão do grupo L\'Oréal, com mais de 30mil colaboradores ao redor do mundo.

Buscamos um profissional sênior com visão sistêmica para liderar a integração entre comunicação de marca e transformação social. O desafio central desta posição éconstruir uma agenda "Always On" de impacto social e sustentabilidade, com foco em comunicação, para as marcas da L’Oréal Grande Público (L’Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline NY, Niely e Colorama).

Este profissional vai liderar a estratégia que conecta os stakeholders internos e externos (ONGs, empresas parceiras, imprensa etc.) em torno de um propósito contínuo. O objetivo é garantir que o compromisso social da divisão e de marcas como L’Oréal Paris (programa StandUp) sejam um pilar perene de reputação e valor de marca, alavancando a reputação e o impacto das marcas com diferentes comunidades.

  • Idealizar e operar iniciativas de sustentabilidade e impacto social dentro das ações de marca, assegurando que cada lançamento de produto ou evento tenha uma camada de propósito que reforce a reputação da divisão.
  • Atuar como o embaixador da divisão frente ao terceiro setor, estabelecendo parcerias de longo prazo que vão além do apoio financeiro, focando em cocreação e troca de expertises.
  • Mobilizar e engajar os times internos (stakeholders internos) para que a agenda social seja parte da cultura do negócio, transformando colaboradores em embaixadores das causas da divisão.
  • Manter relacionamento estratégico com jornalistas, influenciadores e formadores de opinião para garantir que as ações de impacto social tenham eco e relevância na opinião pública.
  • Apoiar o time de Comunicação e PR em ações de comunicação de marca, incluindo lançamentos e campanhas.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é Ser Uma Pessoa Software Engineer Go Senior:

Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento. Essa pessoa, junto ao time, será responsável por:

Supervisor(a) Operacional - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL

Contexto e Descrição do Projeto

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. O Projeto Light – Exposição Itinerante contempla a realização de uma exposição no Centro Cultural Light, representando a história, o impacto social e o protagonismo da Light ao longo de 120 anos na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, juntamente com o desenvolvimento de atividades imersivas com escolas, com foco em educação ambiental e no consumo consciente, eficiente e seguro de energia elétrica. Em seu segundo ano de vigência, as atividades do projeto foram ampliadas para incluir o apoio ao monitoramento dos espaços de exposição do Centro Cultural Light, contribuindo para a mídia cultural, orientação pública e apoio.

Descrição Resumida do Cargo

O/a Supervisor/a Operacional será responsável por atuar no acompanhamento e na organização das atividades do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento do planejamento, dos prazos e dos procedimentos operacionais. A função é essencial para assegurar a qualidade da execução, o suporte à equipe operacional e o alinhamento das ações às diretrizes institucionais.

Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar, orientar e apoiar a equipe de monitores no desempenho de suas atividades;
  • Planejar, em conjunto com o Time Educativo da Light, as atividades pedagógicas e culturais do projeto;
  • Organizar horários de trabalho, controlar a frequência e monitorar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Acompanhar e supervisionar as atividades operacionais da Exposição;
  • Garantir a qualidade do serviço prestado ao público e a experiência dos visitantes;
  • Zelar pela correta utilização, organização e preservação dos espaços de exposição;
  • Garantir a conformidade com os regulamentos internos, saúde, segurança e preservação ambiental;
  • Apoiar a elaboração de relatórios técnicos e dos indicadores de projeto correspondentes.

Rio De Janeiro, Rio De Janeiro, Brasil

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

A nossa cultura se manifesta em cada encontro e em cada diálogo, seja entre colegas de trabalho ou com clientes, seja nas reuniões internas ou em nossas respostas às transformações do mercado e aos momentos de adversidade.

Desejamos que cada pessoa sinta orgulho de ser quem é e que sinta ainda mais orgulho de fazer parte da nossa história.

A essência de “ser quem você é” nos guia, inspirando a construção diária de um ambiente livre, que celebra e valoriza as singularidades. Sabemos que cada pessoa traz consigo uma perspectiva única e valiosa. O que nos une é a inteligência, a energia e a integridade – virtudes que podem e devem ser cultivadas em qualquer pessoa.

Nos dedicaremos todos os dias para garantir que nossas práticas, nossa cultura e nosso ambiente estejam sempre orientados pela inclusão, acessibilidade e respeito.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  • Own It : Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  • Live the Ride : Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  • No Bullshit : Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
  • Team Play : Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  • The Reason : O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Nossa missão é conquistar novos clientes de forma ativa e consultiva através do canal telefônico. Para isso, fazemos um atendimento personalizado com o objetivo de entregar as melhores experiências para o cliente. O time de Outbound está em expansão com o desafio de aumentar a base de clientes através da oferta dos nossos produtos de adquirência.

Como é ser um(a) Analista Comercial de Inside Sales no time de Outbound:

Através do conhecimento sobre o nosso negócio e nossos produtos, você irá realizar as vendas ativas por meio de uma ferramenta de discagem automática.

Você será responsável por realizar vendas ativas aplicando nosso processo de venda, diagnosticando as demandas do cliente, conectando as necessidades dele com as nossas soluções financeiras e com foco em um atendimento de excelência!

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender as ligações realizadas pela discagem automática;
  • Diagnosticar a necessidade do(a) cliente e conectar nossas soluções para o fechamento da venda;
  • Ter uma boa organização dos clientes em negociação, se certificando de fazer follow-up;
  • Gerar proposta no sistema e certificar que está entregando a melhor proposta ao cliente, acompanhando até o fechamento;
  • Acompanhar seus resultados e do time através de dashboards e reuniões.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia com vendas ativas via telefone (no mínimo 1 ano);
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de vendas;
  • Ensino superior (cursando ou concluído);
  • Habilidades de negociação e influência;
  • Boa oratória e escrita;
  • Capacidade de priorização e de lidar com múltiplas tarefas;
  • Habilidade com ferramentas de CRM (ex: Salesforce);
  • Estar sempre em busca de novas atualizações sobre produtos e ofertas da companhia.

O que aumenta suas chances:

  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas;

  • Habilidades com gerenciamento de processos;
  • Facilidade com atendimento ao telefone.

title: Senior Global Recruiter
description:
About Nu

Nu is the world’s largest digital banking platform outside of Asia, serving over 117 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Learn more:

People and Culture at Nubank

Our team works on identifying, attracting, reaching out, assessing, engaging, nurturing and hiring top-notch talent that can strengthen Nubank´s culture.

We’re looking for a passionate, data-driven Senior Recruiter to join our global Talent Acquisition team. You’ll play a critical role in helping us scale our product teams, identifying top-tier talent, and shaping an inclusive candidate experience across borders.

You’ll work closely with business leaders, hiring managers, and cross-functional partners to drive full-cycle recruitment strategies and bring in exceptional talent that shares our mission and values.

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

As a Senior Recruiter, you’re expected to:

  • Own and drive full-cycle recruitment
  • Build strong, consultative partnerships with hiring managers, understanding their needs and advising on best hiring practices.
  • Source and engage passive candidates through creative channels and market research.
  • Deliver high-touch candidate experiences that reflect Nubank’s values of transparency, empathy, and simplicity.
  • Use data and metrics to inform recruiting strategies and continuously improve pipeline health and process efficiency.
  • Partner with employer branding, people analytics, and HR teams to align hiring efforts with business goals.

You will be a great fit if you have:

  • Experience in full-cycle recruiting, ideally in fast-paced, product-driven companies.
  • A strong understanding of the talent landscape, especially in Brazil and LATAM.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple searches and stakeholders with a solutions-oriented approach.
  • Experience with sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Gem, etc.).
  • Passion for candidate experience, inclusive hiring, and employer brand.
  • Advanced English is required; Spanish is a plus.

Nice to have:

  • Experience recruiting across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Previous exposure to fintech or hypergrowth environments.

Why Nubank?

  • Purpose-driven work that impacts millions of people.
  • Collaborative and inclusive remote culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Learning and development support to grow your career.
  • Opportunity to help shape the future of financial services.
  • Health, dental and life insurance
  • Transportation assistance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Equity at Nubank
  • Parking partnership - discounted parking in our office
  • Free bike parking with showers available
  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
  • Extended maternity and paternity Leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or twelve weeks of remote work, one will be at the office. Check moreinformation here.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nu, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That's why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring neither of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.

title: Senior Fraud Auditor- Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
Overview

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.

We are seeking a Fraud Investigator to join the Internal Special Audits Division.

The Internal Special Audits Division is responsible for conducting highly sensitive investigations into issues involving fraud, conflicts of interest, waste, and abuse to provide the management and the Board of Directors with reports, analyses, recommendations, and information concerning the activities reviewed. The Special Audits Division also helps addressing fraud risk management across the Company with programs of awareness, policy and risk consulting, and proactive risk mitigation measures.

Your primary role is to conduct confidential investigations involving misconduct by employees and contractors, while seeking to identify and develop relevant facts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead or support time-sensitive investigations.
  • Become familiar with and utilize data mining and analytical techniques to both identify potential fraud and gather corroborating evidence to support investigations.
  • Become familiar with and utilize Enterprise Risk Management tools (i.e., SAP) to obtain data in support of investigations.
  • Provide fraud awareness presentations throughout the Company to varying job specialties and levels of management.
  • Liaise and coordinate with other fraud-related stakeholder departments including Corporate Security, Law, Personnel and Labor Relations.
  • Draft timely investigative reports and verbally communicate results.
  • Provide on-the-job training and mentoring to less experienced staff.
  • Work independently yet effectively within a team of experienced professionals
  • As a successful candidate, you will hold a bachelor degree in accounting, finance, human resources, law, criminology, compliance, computer. an advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 10 years of experience in forensic accounting, fraud investigation, auditing, law enforcement, compliance, or a related field where you utilized and developed expert interviewing and investigative techniques.
  • You will have at least one professional certification, such as the Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Professional Certified Investigator (PCI), Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) and Certified Public Accountant (CPA).
  • You must demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills in English with solid presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • You should be able to quickly evaluating allegations of fraud, abuse and conflicts of interest and determine the violation of the law, regulations, or Company policy.
  • You should have effective and modern investigative techniques to quickly unravel, explain, and report complicated fraud and conflicts of interest schemes.
  • You should be able analyze facts and evidence and form evidence-based conclusions concerning violations of the law, regulations, or Company policy.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Brazil - RJ - Rio de Janeiro: Tech Lead
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

title: Sales Quality Jr Manager
description:
Company Overview

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada.

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um pouco mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

#LI-Hybrid

Team Overview

You will join, as an individual contributor, the newly established Commercial Quality team within our Commercial Enablement structure at 99Food, an operation committed to scaling high-performance field sales with the right skills, consistency, and impact. Your mission is to act as the "quality gatekeeper", monitoring everything that may go wrong in the sales operation, from skill execution to system usage and process adherence, and ensuring rapid diagnosis and correction. This role combines on-the-ground observation, data-driven auditing, and strategic feedback, driving immediate action and long-term improvement in our sales engine.

Role Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and own a comprehensive Sales Quality framework, including deep-dive audits, scorecards (technical, behavioral, process, system use), and structured feedback mechanisms.
  • Conduct audits across the commercial journey, observing field visits, CRM/system logs, demos, emails, and adherence to playbooks, to identify deviations and opportunities.
  • Manage with the team, frequent field visits alongside Business Developers to observe live execution, assess coaching needs, and validate actual vs. documented behavior.
  • Analyze usage patterns in CRMs and other commercial tools to detect gaps, underutilization, or misuse, feeding insights back into training, KB, and process improvement.
  • Act as a guardian of excellence: monitor compliance with playbooks, process flow, KB, and use of tools, and ensure alignment for every BD interaction.
  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, Operations, and Tech teams to translate QA findings into enhancements, improving Knowledge Base, training modules, workflows, and system improvements.
  • Produce recurring reports on QA insights, emerging gaps, trends, and prioritized recommendations for rapid corrective action and strategic evolution.
  • Coach and mentor QA Specialists, promoting a culture of continuous improvement, consistency, and data-based quality execution.
  • Advocate for operational, process, and systemic improvements with a hypothesis-driven mindset, strong alignment with broader Quality Control principles.

Role Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5–7 years of experience in quality management, process auditing, Sales QA, especially in field sales, tech, or scaling environments.
  • Proven ability to design robust QA frameworks, including scorecards, performance grids, audit routines, and escalation pathways.
  • High analytical capacity: you convert both quantitative data (CRM, metrics, dashboards) and qualitative observations (field, demos) into actionable insights.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, site/system usage tracking, and understanding of how systems impact commercial behavior.
  • Hands-on mindset and physical presence: comfortable conducting field visits, in-person assessments, and working closely with on-the-ground teams.
  • Strong communication skills, with assertiveness to raise operational gaps and collaborate across functions to solve them.
  • A mindset of continuous improvement, with proven results in bringing quality insights into actionable interventions (training, KB updates, process/system refinements).
  • Certifications like Six Sigma / Black Belt or Enablement experience are a plus.

EEO Statement

  • Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar.
  • Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica.
  • Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a DiDi. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos.
  • Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos.
  • Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo.
  • Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra.
  • Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nosso sucesso.
  • Vivemos a Diversidade - Para nós, o coração da diversidade é a inclusão, a igualdade e o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje.

Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias.

description:
Job Overview

The Principal ROV Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex ROV (Mar)-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal ROV Specialist may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in ROV (Mar). As such, they must have in-depth expertise in ROV (Mar) as well as broad knowledge of the ROV (Mar) discipline within the Marine function.

Essential Qualifications and Education

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in offshore remote subsea system design and operations
  • Min. 8 years of experience supporting construction projects
  • Good command of English both oral and written
  • Proficient in the use of subsea ROV & ROV tooling systems
  • Previous offshore experience
  • Proven experience working with ROVs and tooling packs
  • Willingness to travel
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in Subsea Remote Systems design, functioning, and operation (ROV, ROV Tooling, subsea architecture, connectors, flying leads…)
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in the design, functioning, and operation of remote subsea tooling associated with ROV and subsea hardware operation
  • Good Project Engineering skills and experience
  • Previous knowledge in dealing with ROV and Subsea EPC contractors
  • Good understanding of QHSE
  • Proficient knowledge of technical software: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor
  • Proficient knowledge of project software: Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Oversee ROV requirements on assigned project
  • Oversee ROV Tooling Requirements
  • Oversee Commissioning Tooling Requirements
  • Carry out ROV access studies and checks
  • Desktop studies
  • Ensure efficient and excellent integration of the subsea interfaces of SURF project to the marine operations execution

Deliverables

  • Conduct live audits of ROV contractor's premises/offshore in conjunction with Marine QHSE and provide feedback on system and personnel performance/opportunities for improvement
  • Ensure ROV contractors comply with statutory and IMCA guidelines
  • Prepare ROV contractor mobilization audits to ensure readiness/compliance with contract specifications
  • Liaison with Clients / ROV contractors both on and offshore to confirm operational status
  • Research and assessment of latest ROV techniques/equipment so MDR remains up to date and for possible inclusion into Marine Operations/standards

Project Deliverables

  • Issue installation procedure for subsea hardware installation/operation
  • Issue equipment/material specifications for remote subsea tooling and installation aids
  • Provide expertise to the project team to review the subsea installation philosophy of the main subsea components (flexible, umbilical, suction pile, manifold, SDU, and flying lead installation) and proper implementation into the installation procedure
  • Provide input to subsea Pre-Commissioning / Commissioning activities for key contractors
  • Manage interface with subsea hardware EPC contractor and review subsea material delivered to enable a smooth integration of all supplied subsea components into the installation method
  • Ensure that the EPC Contractor meets the technical quality and timely delivery of their deliverables
  • Provide technical / construction support as part of the subsea team in dealing with key vendors
  • Participate in Installation Constructability Reviews and HAZID’s
  • Ensure that the offshore execution is performed safely, timely, and as efficiently as possible, providing quality reporting throughout the offshore period

Reports to

  • Functional: Director ROV Operations
  • Regional: MAO And Senior Manager Marine Operations
  • Project/Construction Manager when assigned to the project
  • Supervises: Ops Engineers/Field Engineers/Draftspersons
  • Liaise with: All Marine operations personnel, functional managers, Engineering design teams, project engineering, tendering teams, procurement/subcontract coordinators, and clients

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Uniforms Senior Manager is responsible for the planning and operational delivery of the corporate FIFA27 Business Casual uniform as well as the FWWC2027 Tournament Dedicated and FIFA Formal uniform programmes in line with the overall FIFA Uniform Strategy and the approved usage and entitlement matrix.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for full project management and implementation of the FWWC2027 uniform programme including issuance operations that support both workforce and volunteers
  • Ensure all FIFA27 workforce have uniform according to the entitlement and usage matrix
  • Effectively collaborate with key FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 stakeholders including Workforce Planning, Volunteer Management, Host City Management, Logistics, Accreditation and Partnership Rights Delivery
  • Create strategy, process and flows for the full project plan for FWWC2027 uniform programme capturing risks and mitigations throughout

  • Oversee FIFA27 uniform budget, including creating accurate forecasts for each FIFA27 related event e.g. FWWC2027 Draw
  • Manage relationships with external uniform suppliers that may be required, ensuring compliance in line with Framework Agreement and enforcing contractual obligations

  • Manage stock levels and keep up-to-date records of each uniform item during pre-tournament (e.g. Business Casual uniform/ formal items that may be required for side events) and tournament time.
  • Communicate the agreed FIFA27 Uniform Guidelines and Usage Policy at each FIFA tournament and event
  • Ensure the uniform guidelines are upheld and enforced across all client groups including FIFA Formal Uniform eligibility
  • Plan uniform distribution to all related FWW2027 additional events, e.g. Final Draw
  • Work with relevant FIFA27 stakeholders to agree and provide guidelines to Suppliers who are not entitled to Tournament Dedicated Uniforms
  • Other duties as necessary to ensure the smooth running of the FWWC2027 Uniform operations.

Your Profile

Qualifications and Experience

  • Minimum experience of 3 years in Uniform Management; preferably with experience in mega (sports) events and corporate organisations

  • Knowledge of event planning and event project management processes

  • Proven track record in administering uniform projects across complex quantity structures
  • Team Player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence, with a pragmatic approach to solving problems
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to balance competing priorities
  • Demonstrate initiative and a strong focus on providing a high level of service

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly overseeing the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Legacy Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager, under the guidance of the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

Key responsibilities

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long-lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
  1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
  2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGO’s and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender-based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society.
  3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post-tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

Your profile

  • Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations: Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Legacy Development
  • Proven track record of developing and implementing legacy strategies.
  • Experience in Project Management including planning, organizing, and delivering complex projects and campaigns.
  • Experience in delivering post-event reporting.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Relations:
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high-level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
  • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials.
  • Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience:
  • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).
  • Right to work in Brazil and ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

description:

Atuar como referência técnica do time, liderando o desenvolvimento e a evolução de soluções de software, dados e integrações com IA, garantindo qualidade técnica, sustentabilidade arquitetural e entrega contínua de valor ao negócio.   • Liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento, apoiando decisões de design, arquitetura e implementação;

  • Traduzir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em soluções técnicas viáveis, avaliando alternativas e escolhendo as soluções tecnológicas mais adequadas, considerando trade-offs de qualidade, prazo, custo, escalabilidade, segurança e impacto operacional;
  • Contribuir ativamente para a evolução da arquitetura de aplicações, dados e integrações, garantindo consistência, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade;
  • Garantir a adoção de boas práticas de engenharia de software, como testes automatizados, versionamento, revisão de código, documentação e integração contínua;
  • Apoiar a construção e evolução de pipelines de dados, integrações assíncronas e soluções que se conectem a modelos de IA quando aplicável;
  • Atuar como ponto de referência técnica para o time, promovendo mentoria, troca de conhecimento e evolução da maturidade técnica;
  • Participar de discussões técnicas com produto, dados e áreas parceiras, apoiando decisões táticas e operacionais;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria técnica e propor soluções que aumentem eficiência, confiabilidade e qualidade do produto;
  • Criar ou evoluir componentes reutilizáveis, padrões e frameworks/plataformas quando necessário para acelerar o desenvolvimento;
  • Apoiar a priorização técnica do backlog, sinalizando riscos, dependências e impactos arquiteturais;
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes, investigando causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais;
  • Contribuir para a evolução dos processos de engenharia, alinhados aos objetivos de curto e médio prazo da área;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências de mercado, arquitetura, dados e IA, disseminando conhecimento no time;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas do time, influenciando práticas, priorização de tarefas e promovendo evolução contínua da qualidade técnica;
  • Propor inovações aplicáveis ao roadmap do produto, realizando provas de conceito e estudos de caso que aumentem competitividade, eficiência e qualidade da solução.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Sólida experiência em Desenvolvimento Delphi;
  • Domínio no desenvolvimento de APIs (REST-HORSE) e API First;
  • Fundamento em testes unitários – Conhecimento em Dunit;
  • Unigui e Firemonkey – Nível avançado;
  • Banco de Dados PostgreSQL, MongoDB ou equivalentes;
  • Arquitetura de software moderna, cloud native, microsserviços e orientada a eventos;
  • Design Patterns, Clean Code e princípios de engenharia de software;
  • Segurança no desenvolvimento e práticas de DevSecOps;
  • Linguagem de programação avançada (Java ou equivalente) e frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot e Spring Cloud);
  • NoSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalentes;
  • Mensageria, RabbitMQ, Pub Sub ou equivalentes;
  • IA e LLMs: uso via API, prompts, RAG e integração de IA em aplicações;
  • Noções de pipelines de dados, Airflow, Beam ou equivalentes.

  • Work closely with the Senior Partnership Development Manager, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Identify and pursue high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Source, qualify, and engage potential sponsors, securing meetings and presenting tailored partnership proposals to major regional and international brands.
  • Develop bespoke sponsorship packages that address the unique needs and objectives of prospective partners.
  • Lead negotiations through to successful acquisition, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s commercial guidelines and values.
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Establish and nurture long-term relationships with key sponsor prospects, ensuring continuity and value beyond the tournament.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for the FIFA27 team in Brazil on sales-related matters, supporting or managing the sales process as needed.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Build strong external visibility for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ commercial opportunities, fostering inbound interest and leads through proactive industry engagement.
  • Lead and support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your profile

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.
  • Strong presenter and excellent relationship building skills.
  • Proven experience in sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Strong network and understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Experience in dealing with and negotiating within different cultures.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Sales CRM tools
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.
